summary: Given angular momentum commutators [Li,xj]=iħεijk xk, [Li,Lj]=iħεijk Lk and noncommuting coordinates [xi,xj]=(iħ/m²c²)εijk Lk, find constants α,β so that Ji=αxi+βLi satisfy angular momentum algebra, and show position coordinates are quantized in multiples of half the Compton wavelength ħ/mc.
